text:
samir: FYI — saw a handful of prod 403s turn into 200s on embeddings endpoints after yesterday's RBAC PR. Suspect scope shadowing.

jess: do you have a repro? which routes/models?

samir: Repro: send embeddings request to /v1/embeddings with token A (per-route: chat-only) -> got 200 and embedding returned. Log snippet:
```
[t=2026-03-20T09:12:34Z] auth=token-A scope=chat_only route=/v1/embeddings model=text-embed-ada-002 result=OK
```
Seems like per-route allowlist check fell back to wildcard legacy policy in auth service.

olivia: can you confirm if the KMS rekey finished yesterday? I pushed the RBAC refactor + a small cache TTL change.

samir: yes rekey completed ~08:50 UTC. RBAC PR merged 08:40. Servers reloaded policies ~08:55.

kyle: if rekey changed key tags, authz cache could miss metadata and treat route as untagged -> fallback to legacy-permission. This matches.

jess: we need audit trail: which tokens used, which user/route. Can we run a query on request_logs with token_hash?

samir: running quick query:
```
SELECT token_id, route, user_id, event_ts FROM request_logs
WHERE event_ts >= '2026-03-20T08:30:00Z' AND route LIKE '/v1/embeddings%'
AND result='OK' LIMIT 50;
```
I see 7 distinct token_ids that should have been blocked.

sec-bot: Alert: potential scope-enforcement regression detected. Affected tokens: token-ids x7. Created incident: INC-2026-145

olivia: mitigation: 1) temp revoke affected tokens 2) patch auth to treat missing KMS metadata as DENY not fallback 3) roll back RBAC cache TTL change

kyle: agree. Also, add a migration to backfill key tags into authz cache from KMS metadata and revalidate cached entries.

jess: action owners: samir revoke tokens + list; olivia patch + deploy; kyle backfill script; ops — coordinate token rotation with 2-hour SLA.

samir: I'll revoke and paste list + commands.

samir: revoked tokens: token-ids [tkn123, tkn456, tkn789, tkn234, tkn567, tkn890, tkn999]

samir: commands used:
```
# revoke
./admin revoke-token --id tkn123 --reason 'scope-enforcement-regression'
# audit link
SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE token_id='tkn123' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20;
```

olivia: patch in review, adding unit tests for per-route precedence and KMS-metadata-missing path. Will post PR shortly.

jess: need audit log enhancement: include policy_version and key_tag in request_logs so we can debug replays.

kyle: also enable an eval job that fuzzes combinations: {token_scope, route_scope, model_scope, missing_kms_metadata} weekly.

samir: postmortem scheduled 2026-03-21 10:00 UTC. I'll attach logs + repro. Closing loop after mitigation validated.

olivia: thanks all. One note: don't rotate KMS root again until backfill done.

jess: noted. :thumbsup:
